notes:
- Klipy ships with the app's key and is the default GIF index, so GIF search answers out of the box; a key of your own in Settings still replaces the bundled one.
- Comment-media and token keystore decryption left the collector's main thread, and the token store now decrypts each ciphertext once per session instead of twice per read.
- The dashboard's full-list walks and the copy fold run inside one Default-dispatcher block instead of on the main thread; the inbox tab merges once per change instead of five times.
- A burst of expired snapshots rewrites the whole kind file once instead of once per entry.
